title: Response-Time Proration of the Emergency Dispatch Charge, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Clause.** How the emergency dispatch charge under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty is taken from the scheduled dispatch charge follows the technician's response hours against the program's emergency response hours: a response of more than twice the program's emergency response hours carries no dispatch charge; a response longer than the program's emergency response hours but not more than twice them carries the scheduled dispatch charge prorated by the program's emergency response hours divided by the response hours; a response within the program's emergency response hours carries the whole scheduled dispatch charge.

The response hours are the hours from the emergency report to the technician's arrival, as recorded for the dispatch.

## Thresholds by program

| Program | Emergency response hours | Whole charge up to and including | Prorated above that, up to and including | No charge above |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 24 | 24 hours | 48 hours | 48 hours |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 24 | 24 hours | 48 hours | 48 hours |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 24 | 24 hours | 48 hours | 48 hours |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 12 | 12 hours | 24 hours | 24 hours |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 12 | 12 hours | 24 hours | 24 hours |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 4 | 4 hours | 8 hours | 8 hours |

## Worked cases (hypothetical scheduled dispatch charge USD 80.00, program response hours 12)

| Response hours | Band | Charge taken from the scheduled charge |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | within 12 | USD 80.00 |
| 12 | within 12 | USD 80.00 |
| 16 | over 12, not over 24 | 80.00 multiplied by 12 and divided by 16, which is USD 60.00 |
| 24 | over 12, not over 24 | 80.00 multiplied by 12 and divided by 24, which is USD 40.00 |
| 25 | over 24 | none |
